title: hyphae
description: The tubular filament that is the fungal body's thread: a chitin-walled tube, partitioned by septa or coenocytic, fusing with other hyphae (anastomosis) and growing at its tip. Generated by the fungus threading.

filament.description: a chitin-walled tube of cytoplasm, septate or coenocytic

tip-growth.description: extends by apical growth and fuses by anastomosis into a network
